verdict.rationale: The README gives per-harness install commands for Claude Code (official marketplace plugin), Codex (plugin marketplace add/add) and Copilot (plugin marketplace add/install). A universal `npx skills@latest add` installer also lets you pick which agents to target, and the site states it works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot. Missing for 10: no Cursor-specific install instructions beyond the generic npx installer and the compatibility claim, and no independent hands-on confirmation that the same set behaves equivalently across harnesses.
